body.name: Feasible-frame handle for the exact fixed-budget frontier
body.construction: To evaluate \(\rho_k(K,R)\), reduce each positive-denominator pair \((L,T)\) to its Schur complement \(H\) and the two hemisphere lifts \(z(u_0),z(u_1)\).  Parameterize those lifts by their normalized spherical midpoint and unit tangent.  Bound the exact singleton chordal losses through the diagonally normalized matrix obtained from \(H^{1/2}QH^{1/2}\), where \(Q\) is the midpoint rank-one contraction, and retain the endpoint vertical-coordinate constraint induced by \(R\).  Optimize over \(1\le |T|\le k\) without replacing the exact angular loss \(g\) by a global Lipschitz envelope; use the separate zero-information elbow when \(R=1\).
